eventID: An identifier for the set of information associated with a dwc:Event (something that occurs at a place and time). May be a global unique identifier or an identifier specific to the data set.
syntaxonName: The description (not a code) of the plant community or vegetation unit associated with the relevé See also http://www.iavs.org/pdf/Code.pdf
aspect: The compass direction that the relevé site faces
inclinationInDegrees: The angle of inclination of the relevé site in degrees, rounded to the nearest whole number
coverTotalInPercentage: The total cover (%) of all plants, rounded to the nearest hundredth (2 decimal places)
coverTreesInPercentage: The cover (%) of trees, rounded to the nearest hundredth (2 decimal places)
coverShrubsInPercentage: The cover (%) of shrubs, rounded to the nearest hundredth (2 decimal places)
coverHerbsInPercentage: The cover (%) of the herb layer, rounded to the nearest hundredth (2 decimal places)
coverCryptogamsInPercentage: The cover (%) of cryptogams, rounded to the nearest hundredth (2 decimal places)
coverMossesInPercentage: The cover (%) of mosses, rounded to the nearest hundredth (2 decimal places)
coverLichensInPercentage: The cover (%) of lichens, rounded to the nearest hundredth (2 decimal places)
coverAlgaeInPercentage: The cover (%) of algae, rounded to the nearest hundredth (2 decimal places)
coverLitterInPercentage: The cover (%) of litter, rounded to the nearest hundredth (2 decimal places)
coverWaterInPercentage: The cover (%) of open water, rounded to the nearest hundredth (2 decimal places)
coverRockInPercentage: The cover (%) of bare rock, rounded to the nearest hundredth (2 decimal places)
treeLayerHeightInMeters: The height in meters of the tree layer, rounded to the nearest whole number
shrubLayerHeightInMeters: The height in meters of the shrub layer, can be written in decimal notation
herbLayerHeightInCentimeters: The height in centimeters of the high herb layer, rounded to the nearest whole number
mossesIdentified: The value is true if mosses in the releve were identified
lichensIdentified: The value is true if lichens in the releve were identified

mossesIdentified: Boolean term. "True" "False", or left empty if unknown.
lichensIdentified: Boolean term. "True" "False", or left empty if unknown.
